stem: Leanor pays a total of $16.50 for every 6 shirts she has dry-cleaned. Which graph models a relationship with the same unit rate?
visual_elements: Graph F with points rising from (0,0) to (10,30) approximately
Graph H with points rising from (0,0) to (5,50) approximately
Graph G with points rising from (0,0) to (3,50) approximately
Graph J with points rising from (0,0) to (2,50) approximately
notes: Unit rate is $16.50/6 shirts = $2.75 per shirt. Graph must have slope 2.75.
